# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.

items.t: Kerala's free health cover, run together with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. About 42 lakh poorer families get treatment worth up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at about 180 government and 365 private empanelled hospitals. The KASP card is made at the KASP help desk of an empanelled hospital or at an Akshaya centre after an Aadhaar check. The new government plans to merge KASP into a bigger Oommen Chandy Health Insurance Scheme, but until that is notified KASP cards keep working as before.
Up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
Families that had an RSBY or CHIS health card in 2018-19, and families on the PM-JAY list (SECC 2011), including those who got the letter from the Prime Minister
About 42 lakh families, the poorest 40% of Kerala. Every member is covered, whatever the age or the size of the family
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one. Costs for 3 days before admission and 15 days after discharge are included
Other families cannot join now. New names are added only when the government announces it

A seriously ill patient from a poor family that is not in KASP can ask the same hospital desk about the Karunya Benevolent Fund: Rs.2 lakh for illnesses such as cancer and heart disease, Rs.3 lakh for kidney disease
Aadhaar card of every family member who needs a card
Old RSBY or CHIS card, or the letter from the Prime Minister, if you have one
At admission: the KASP card (or its number) and the patient's Aadhaar

The KASP (PM-JAY) help desk at any empanelled government or private hospital, such as a medical college, district or taluk hospital, or any Akshaya e-Kendra. Take the Aadhaar card of every member who needs a card, the ration card and a mobile phone. There is no paper form: the staff search your family on the computer and check each member's Aadhaar.

Go to the KASP desk of an empanelled hospital or an Akshaya centre with each member's Aadhaar, the ration card and your phone.
The staff find your family, check each member's Aadhaar by fingerprint or OTP, take a photo and print the KASP card.
When treatment is needed, go to an empanelled hospital and show the KASP card and Aadhaar at the KASP counter before admission.
The hospital takes approval from the State Health Agency. Medicines, tests, surgery, ICU, room and food in the package are free; do not pay cash for a covered treatment.

Not on the list but seriously ill and poor? Ask the same desk how to apply to the Karunya Benevolent Fund.

Social Security Pension (Kshema Pension / Sevana Pension)
Local Self Government Department and Finance Department, Government of Kerala, through grama panchayats, municipalities and corporations

Kerala's monthly welfare pension, Rs.2,000 since November 2025, for poor elderly people, widows, persons with disabilities, unmarried women over 50 and old agricultural labourers. About 52 lakh people get it. Your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation takes the paper form, checks your case and must decide within 45 days. The money comes every month to your bank account, or a co-operative bank agent hands it over at your home. The new government has promised to raise it to Rs.3,000, but no date has been fixed yet.
Rs.2,000 a month
Family income not above Rs.1 lakh a year, and not an income tax payer
Old age pension: 60 or above. Agricultural labourer pension: 60 or above, at least 10 years as a farm labourer and a member of the Agricultural Workers' Welfare Fund
Widow pension: widows who have not remarried, and women of 50 or more whose husband has been missing or has left them for over 7 years. Unmarried women's pension: unmarried women aged 50 or more
Disability pension: persons with 40% or more disability certified by a medical board

Not eligible: land over 2 acres (except ST families), a car over 1000 cc that is not a taxi, a concrete house over 2,000 sq ft with modern flooring, or a government or PSU service or family pension (ex-gratia or NPS pension up to Rs.4,000 is allowed)
Only one social security pension per person (except persons with disability), applied for in the local body where you live permanently
Age proof: school certificate, birth certificate, church or mosque record, voter ID or Aadhaar

Priyadarshini Scheme (Free KSRTC Bus Travel for Women)
Transport Department, Government of Kerala — Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC)

Since 15 June 2026, women and transgender persons travel free on KSRTC ordinary buses in Kerala, with no limit on distance. There is no form, card or registration, and no ID is needed: tell the conductor where you are going and take the zero-fare Priyadarshini ticket. Fast Passenger, City Fast and higher-class buses, festival and weekend specials and chartered trips are not free.

State Crop Insurance Scheme and Crop-Loss Relief (AIMS)
Department of Agriculture Development and Farmers' Welfare, Government of Kerala, through Krishi Bhavans

Kerala's own crop insurance. For a small premium, such as Rs.2 a year for a yielding coconut tree or Re.1 a cent for paddy, you get fixed compensation if the crop is fully destroyed by flood, drought, landslide, storm, lightning, sea erosion, wildfire or wild animals; paddy is also covered against pests and disease. You apply and pay on the AIMS portal or app, and the Krishi Bhavan checks the field. Farmers without insurance can still claim the smaller natural-calamity relief on AIMS, for example Rs.700 for a yielding coconut tree. In March 2026 papaya, rambutan and other fruits, flowers and bee boxes were added.
For total loss: Rs.2,000 per yielding coconut tree, Rs.35,000 per hectare of paddy, Rs.300 per bunched Nendran banana
Any farmer in Kerala who cultivates own or leased land. Paddy farmers can also join as a padasekharam group
Minimum to insure: 10 coconut or arecanut trees, 10 banana plants, 25 rubber trees, or 0.1 hectare (about 25 cents) of paddy
Insure within the crop's window: paddy 15 to 45 days after sowing or transplanting, banana 1 to 5 months after planting; yielding tree crops at any time
Insure the whole crop in that plot, not part of it. Old or low-yielding trees are not accepted

Cover starts 7 days after the premium is paid. Only total loss is paid: paddy loss above 50% counts as total, and for vegetables, ginger, tapioca and similar crops at least 10% of the insured area must be lost
Aadhaar card and the mobile number linked to it, for the OTP
Land tax receipt or other land record; a lease agreement if the land is leased

Crop details: number of trees or plants, or the area, and the planting date

For a claim: photos of the damaged crop

The compensation is paid straight into your bank account when funds are released.
If the crop was not insured, apply on AIMS in the same way for natural-calamity relief at the government's lower rates.

Ladakh Universal Health Care Scheme (Golden Card)

Every ration card household gets a Golden Card worth Rs.5 lakh a year for hospital treatment, tests and medicines, cashless at empanelled hospitals. The card is made at the Ayushman desk of a government hospital, at an enrolment camp or at a CSC, using the ration card and Aadhaar.
